en_title: Gearbox Calls on Fans to Help Shape the Next Borderlands, Teases 'Exciting Overall Direction' For the Future of the Franchise
cn_title: Gearbox呼吁粉丝帮助塑造下一款Borderlands，预告系列未来「令人兴奋的整体方向」
opus_summary: Gearbox表示正在探索《Borderlands》系列未来的角色故事线和整体方向，并征求粉丝对下一部作品的意见。《Borderlands 4》第一年DLC路线图已结束，工作室确认明年将推出更多内容，但除每周活动更新和社区挑战外，尚未说明具体内容。

paragraphs.en: Borderlands developer Gearbox has called on fans to let it know what they want next from the next game in the franchise, as work begins on “an exciting overall direction.”
paragraphs.cn: 无主之地开发商Gearbox呼吁粉丝告诉它，他们希望从该系列的下一款游戏中获得什么，同时已开始着手制定「令人兴奋的整体方向」。

paragraphs.en: Borderlands 4 just wrapped up its Year 1 of DLC, and in a note to fans today, Gearbox issued its long-awaited future content announcement, confirming more is coming to the looter shooter next year. “Moving forward, Weekly Activity refreshes and Community Challenges will continue,” Gearbox said. “We just wrapped our Year 1 roadmap, and the team is cooking hard on more Borderlands 4 content for next year.” What this content involves beyond Weekly Activity refreshes and Community Challenges was not specified.
paragraphs.cn: 无主之地 4刚刚结束其第一年的DLC内容，Gearbox今天在给粉丝的一则说明中发布了备受期待的未来内容公告，确认这款刷宝射击游戏明年将迎来更多内容。Gearbox表示：「接下来，每周活动刷新和社区挑战将继续进行。我们刚刚完成第一年路线图，团队正在全力筹备明年推出的更多无主之地 4内容。」除了每周活动刷新和社区挑战之外，这些内容还包括什么，公告并未说明。

paragraphs.en: Gearbox then spoke vaguely about its plans for the future of the Borderlands franchise, asking fans for their opinions.
paragraphs.cn: 随后，Gearbox含糊地谈到了无主之地系列的未来计划，并询问粉丝的意见。

paragraphs.en: “The team is constantly listening to community feedback, and they are exploring additional character arcs, storylines, and an exciting overall direction for the future of the franchise,” Gearbox said.
paragraphs.cn: Gearbox表示：「团队一直在倾听社区反馈，他们正在探索更多角色成长线、故事线，以及系列未来令人兴奋的整体方向。」

paragraphs.en: The studio continued: “... we’re also taking a bigger look at the franchise as a whole. Where can we take it next? What characters do you want to spend more time with? What stories deserve a payoff? A huge part of that is listening to you. Keep the conversation going - we're listening. Tell us what you think! Share your thoughts with us on social and tune into the Gearbox Devcast. We’re always responding to community feedback on that show.”
paragraphs.cn: 该工作室继续说道：「……我们也在从更宏观的角度审视整个系列。接下来我们能将它带向何方？你们想与哪些角色共度更多时光？哪些故事值得得到一个交代？其中很重要的一部分就是倾听你们的声音。继续讨论下去——我们在听。告诉我们你们的想法！在社交媒体上与我们分享你们的想法，并收听Gearbox Devcast。我们一直在那档节目中回应社区反馈。」

paragraphs.en: Don’t hold your breath for the announcement of Borderlands 5 or whatever the next game ends up being called, however. It sounds like early days.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，别急着期待无主之地 5或下一款游戏最终叫什么名字的公布。听起来一切还处于早期阶段。

paragraphs.en: “All that said, big plans take time, and we need some room to work,” Gearbox added. “You can trust that we’ll talk more when the time is right. Now is your chance to influence what we’ll say. We’re listening and we’re working hard for you. Thanks for being with us in the Borderlands.”
paragraphs.cn: Gearbox补充道：「话虽如此，宏大的计划需要时间，我们也需要一些工作空间。请相信，时机成熟时我们会分享更多。现在，你们有机会影响我们将要说的内容。我们在倾听，也在为你们努力工作。感谢你们与我们一同身处无主之地。」

paragraphs.en: The announcement comes as the Borderlands franchise crossed 100 million units sold. Over the summer, fans were questioning how well Borderlands 4 had done not just in terms of launch sales, but continuing player base, and how that might have affected Gearbox's plans, as they waited for confirmation of a second year of support.
paragraphs.cn: 这则公告发布之际，无主之地系列销量已突破1亿份。今年夏天，粉丝们在等待第二年支持计划得到确认的同时，对无主之地 4的表现提出疑问，不仅关注其首发销量，也关注持续游玩的玩家群体，以及这些因素可能如何影响Gearbox的计划。

paragraphs.en: Since launching in September, Borderlands 4 has suffered various controversies, mostly to do with severe PC performance issues. Outspoken CEO Randy Pitchford went on the offensive , responding directly to complaints on social media to Claptrap back at disgruntled fans .
paragraphs.cn: 自9月推出以来，无主之地 4遭遇了各种争议，大多与严重的PC性能问题有关。直言不讳的首席执行官Randy Pitchford主动出击，直接在社交媒体上回应投诉，反击不满的粉丝。

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick, boss of Gearbox parent company Take-Two, previously admitted that Borderlands 4 sales had suffered “a little bit of softness” as a result of the technical issues, but expressed confidence “it’ll all be made up” given enough time. The Nintendo Switch 2 version was scrapped , with Take-Two saying Gearbox had prioritized continued "improvements" to the game on its existing platforms.
paragraphs.cn: Gearbox母公司Take-Two的负责人Strauss Zelnick此前承认，技术问题导致无主之地 4的销量「略显疲软」，但他表示有信心，只要时间足够，「这一切都会得到弥补」。Switch 2版本已被取消，Take-Two表示，Gearbox优先考虑继续「改进」游戏在现有平台上的表现。

paragraphs.en: All the while, Borderlands 4 remains on a ‘mixed’ user review rating on Steam. After launching to over 300,000 concurrent players on Valve’s platform, Borderlands 4 now averages a concurrent peak in the four digits. Steam numbers do not paint the entire picture of a game’s popularity as it’s also on consoles, but it’s clear Borderlands 4 could do with a shot in the arm.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，无主之地 4在Steam上的用户评价仍为「褒贬不一」。在Valve的平台上，无主之地 4首发时的同时在线玩家数超过30万，如今其平均同时在线峰值为四位数。Steam数据并不能完整反映一款游戏的受欢迎程度，因为它也登陆了主机平台，但显然无主之地 4需要一剂强心针。
